name: Wall push-up
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on the wall at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to straight arms.
cues: Keep your body in one straight line.

name: Knee push-up
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up, keeping hips in line.
cues: Squeeze your core so your hips don't sag.

name: Push-up
steps: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until your elbows reach about 90°.
Push the floor away to return to the top.
cues: Elbows at about 45° from your body.

name: Decline push-up
steps: Place your feet on a sturdy chair or step, hands on the floor.
Lower your chest with control.
Press back up.

name: Box squat (to chair)
steps: Stand in front of a chair, feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back until you lightly touch the chair.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.

name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Set your feet just wider than hip-width and keep your whole foot grounded.
Brace your core, send your hips back and bend your knees with control.
Keep your chest open, then press through your feet to stand tall.
cues: Let your knees track in the same direction as your toes.
Go as deep as you comfortably can.

name: Jump squat
steps: Squat down as usual.
Jump straight up explosively.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.
cues: Land quietly on the balls of your feet.

name: Split squat
steps: Stand in a long stride, back heel lifted.
Lower straight down until both knees bend.
Push up through the front foot.

name: Reverse lunge
steps: Stand tall, then step one foot back.
Lower until your front knee bends about 90°.
Drive through the front foot to return.
cues: Front knee stays over the ankle.

name: Walking lunge
steps: Step forward into a lunge.
Bring the back foot through into the next lunge.
Keep a steady rhythm.

name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
steps: Set up as a glute bridge and lift one leg.
Drive your hips up with the planted foot.
Lower with control; switch sides.

name: Calf raise
steps: Stand tall, hold a wall for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lower slowly.

name: Step-up
steps: Face a sturdy step or bench.
Step up with one foot and stand tall.
Step down with control; alternate legs.
cues: Push through the heel of the top foot.

name: Forearm plank
steps: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Lift your body into a straight line.
Hold while breathing steadily.

name: Plank shoulder tap
steps: Start in a high plank.
Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand.
Alternate without rocking your hips.

name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90°.
Extend the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
cues: Keep your lower back pressed down.

name: Bird dog
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Return and switch sides.
cues: Move slowly; keep your hips square.

name: Superman hold
steps: Lie face down, arms forward.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly.
Hold, then lower.
cues: Look at the floor to keep your neck neutral.

name: Mountain climber
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low.
cues: Keep your shoulders over your hands.

name: Step jack (low impact)
steps: Step one foot out while raising your arms.
Step back in and lower your arms.
Alternate sides at a brisk pace.

name: Jumping jack
steps: Jump your feet out while raising your arms.
Jump back in.
Keep a steady rhythm.

name: March in place
steps: Stand tall.
March, lifting your knees to hip height if you can.
Swing your arms.

name: High knees
steps: Run in place, driving your knees up.
Pump your arms.
Stay on the balls of your feet.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down between your knees.
Stand up tall.
cues: Elbows inside your knees at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell bent-over row
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging.
Pull the weights toward your hips.
Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back, sliding the weights down your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
cues: Keep a flat back; soft knees.

name: Lower-body stretch flow
steps: Hamstring stretch, 30 s each side.
Hip-flexor lunge stretch, 30 s each side.
Quad stretch, 30 s each side.

name: Upper-body stretch flow
steps: Chest opener, 30 s.
Cross-body shoulder stretch, 30 s each side.
Triceps stretch, 30 s each side.
